summary: All required IT coverage is present and correct. The graph-mode null-next termination test (`next_null_ends_branch_no_fallthrough`) correctly uses `seedGraphExecution` with id-bearing steps, ensuring `graphMode()` returns true and the new branch executes — the NOTE concern about legacy-path preservation is addressed. Assertions on status, currentStepId, and sentCount are value-based and order-independent. The on_start entry test asserts `currentStepId == "entry"` (not array[0]). The applyTriggers suite covers the full acceptance matrix: valid on_start entryStepId accepted and persisted, dangling id rejected (422), null id accepted, and non-event/non-on_start type rejected. The step-budget backstop test remains valid after the advanceToNext rewrite (cyclic funnel uses explicit next edges, so graphMode=true and the budget still trips). Two minor location mismatches between TDD anchor class names and actual test locations — no assertion quality issues. No critical or major findings.
